Owner answers 2026-10-25 (tier 3): Mark complete on list and grid cards; toast with Undo for 5 s; Page archives at its last page on screen, other modes at the last word. Full Spec by roadmap review 2026-10-25 (U9 pass). Shared core: ReaderContainer.tsx, own window after PAGE-PAGES-READ-1. Not a release gate.

items.title: Focus and Flow chapter steps save the entry's word with its own section's cfi
items.description: On an EPUB, a chapter step or contents jump in Focus (and Flow, Narrate) persists the entry's word with the previous section's cfi before go-to-href lands, so a reopen can land in the old section. Page's landing save is the model.
items.notes: Created 2026-10-23 by roadmap review 2026-10-23-4 from JUMP-LANDING-SAVE-1's live check (e). Stub. Not a release gate.

items.title: After a contents jump, Focus makes the chapter's first word the reading word
items.description: After a contents-list jump in Focus no cursor is painted in the new section. Owner ruling 2026-10-23: the jumped-to chapter's first word becomes the reading word and is saved, as Page does.
items.notes: Created 2026-10-23 by roadmap review 2026-10-23-4; owner ruling 2026-10-23 (tier 3) "First word of chapter". Found live by BAND-ALIGN-2. Stub. Not a release gate.

items.title: Android Auto and Apple CarPlay compatibility
items.description: Narrated books (and podcasts) play through Android Auto and Apple CarPlay: browsable library, now-playing screen, play/pause/skip/rate, position saved. A listening surface only (platform audio templates).
items.notes: Created 2026-10-23 by Blurby.Roadmap at the owner request. Stub; needs owner design decisions (what the car shows, on-phone Kokoro vs server streaming, CarPlay audio entitlement).

items.title: Flow and Focus paragraph pauses land at real paragraph ends
items.description: The paragraph-pause list uses section-local word numbers while Flow and Focus read in whole-book numbers, so pauses land mid-sentence. Build it in whole-book numbering from the paragraph starts the keys code finds.
items.notes: Created 2026-10-23 by Blurby.Roadmap from BLOCK-TAG-CASE-1 Wave A; owner tier-2 decision: hold BLOCK-TAG-CASE-1 merge until this lands, merge together. Stub. Not a release gate.

items.title: Page paragraph keys move the highlight to a real paragraph start
items.description: BUG-220: in Page, Shift+right moves the highlight from 187 to -1 and Shift+left to 0; probably the paragraph command's slice index.
items.notes: origin: Blurby.Brain finding during package verification, filed by roadmap review 2026-10-25. Stub; needs a trace on the held key-fix stack. Not a release gate.

items.title: Page turns count toward the pages-read goal
items.description: Page-mode forward turns add their words to the reading goal's pages count, with carry between turns; the furthest mark owns the count.
items.notes: origin: roadmap review 2026-10-25, split from PAGE-SAVE-RESTAMP-3 Wave C. Full Spec (U9 pass). Shared-core touch: ReaderContainer.tsx, own integration window after the Stage 8 merge train. Not a release gate.

items.title: A library edit stamps only what the reader changed; a missing book fails the save; a save answers only its own form
items.description: W2 (BUG-223): edit-doc-fields sends edited fields with loaded values and main stamps only those; N1: update-doc on a missing id errors; N2: a request token ties a save to its form.
items.notes: origin: LIBRARY-WRITE-RACE-2 memo (W2, N1, N2); Blurby.Brain ruling relayed by Blurby.Roadmap 2026-10-25; specified by roadmap review 2026-10-25 (U9 pass). Shared core: src/types.ts, own window after APP-TABS-1. Must merge before BLURBY-SERVER-1.

items.title: The furthest page a reader reached is remembered across sessions
items.description: Save furthestPosition and furthestCfi (only when higher) through the progress IPC, so the backtrack prompt survives a quit.
items.notes: origin: roadmap review 2026-10-25, split from PAGE-SAVE-RESTAMP-3 Wave C. Owner ruling 2026-10-25 (tier 2): the backtrack prompt offers the furthest page ever reached. Stub, needs a full spec; touches src/types.ts (shared core). Not a release gate.

items.title: In Narrate, an arrow with a modifier key pauses and the cursor holds its word
items.description: Owner ruling 2026-10-25: Shift/Ctrl/Alt/Meta + left/right pauses Narrate; plain arrows and PageUp/Down unchanged; Narrate-local key listener.
